{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_rows = sales[qa_mask]

# Confirm: there are 6 QA rows
print(f'Number of QA rows in full dataset: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Count how many of the QA rows are in the loyal_completed group
qa_in_loyal = loyal_completed[qa_mask]
print(f'Number of QA rows among loyal completed orders: {len(qa_in_loyal)}')

# Remove all QA rows from the loyal_completed group
real_orders = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print final evidence
print(f'Final number of valid loyal completed orders: {len(real_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
